verdict.rationale: Cline documents a native desktop app for macOS and Windows that runs agent sessions in any folder. Visual diff review and parallel agents are documented, but in other surfaces: the VS Code/JetBrains extensions and the web-based Kanban board. The evidence does not show both together inside the desktop app. Missing for 10: explicit visual diff review inside the desktop app, explicit side-by-side multi-session view in the desktop app, independent hands-on corroboration of the desktop app.

support.subject: As a developer, I can review diffs visually and run multiple sessions side by side in a desktop app

citations.quote: Cline as a native app for macOS and Windows.

Run agent sessions in any folder, schedule
routines, and manage models, plugins, and MCP servers.
In VS Code and JetBrains, every edit shows up as a diff you can review, modify, or revert.
Review diffs in card detail view and leave inline comments.
Use Cline Kanban to run multiple coding agents in parallel with isolated git worktrees.
